question: Which of the following is an important step towards offering primary education to all children between the ages of 6 and 14?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarva Siksha Abhiyan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarva Siksha Abhiyan** is a government program aimed at the **universalization of primary education**.
 
• It focuses on **providing free and compulsory education** to all children between the ages of **6 and 14**.
 
• The program was launched in 2001 and aims to bridge social, regional, and gender gaps in education.
 
• It also emphasizes improving the quality of education through reforms in teacher training, curriculum, and school infrastructure.
 
• Sarva Siksha Abhiyan is a flagship program under the **Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Mid-day meal** scheme, while important for increasing school attendance and nutritional levels, is not solely focused on universalizing primary education.
 
• The **Adult Education Programme** targets individuals above the age of 15 and aims to improve literacy rates among adults, not primary education for children.
 
• **Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan** aims to enhance access to secondary education and improve its quality, focusing on students aged 14 to 18.
